relations.rationale: Both describe rehearsal events but do not directly imply one another beyond general sequence in the same rehearsal.
Warmup scales rising and falling has no bearing on relative ages of Xavi and Otto.
The room quieting during scales does not relate to Xavi's need for more practice.
Scales rising and falling during warmups has no bearing on how the song later ended.
Warmup quieting is unrelated to the group applauding at the end of the night.
Otto being older than Kai says nothing about Kai's age relative to Xavi.
If Otto is older than Kai, this doesn't directly determine whether Xavi is older than Otto, though it's logically independent.
Hana cannot simultaneously be standing near the window humming and flipping through her folder, so these are contradictory actions unless sequential, but as stated they conflict.
Kai being older than Xavi has no bearing on the rehearsal moving to a new piece.
Kai older than Xavi combined with Xavi older than Otto would be consistent, but claim 15 alone doesn't establish Xavi's age relative to Otto.
Kai's age relative to Xavi has no connection to Hana's suggestion about rehearsing the closing number.
The rehearsal moving to a new piece directly sets up the description of that piece's tricky harmonies.
Moving to a new piece doesn't inherently relate to whether Kai's part had gotten easier since last rehearsal.
Moving into a new piece is a separate event from Hana's later suggestion to run the closing number again.
Moving to a new piece doesn't specify how that piece or any song ended.
Tricky harmonies requiring run-throughs would plausibly cause Xavi to struggle at first to find his note.
Tricky harmonies needing run-throughs support the idea that Xavi eventually locked in after practice.
Tricky harmonies requiring multiple run-throughs supports the idea that Xavi still needed more practice.
Xavi struggling at first to find his note sets up and supports his eventual locking in with the basses.
Xavi's initial struggle with his note is unrelated to whether Kai's part had gotten easier.
